cues: The tense errors examiners see most.
I am knowing: stative verbs like know, believe, want and own are not used in the continuous, so I know.
He has gone to Pokhara last week: the present perfect never takes a finished past time, so he went.
I am working here since twenty twenty: with since, the present perfect continuous, I have been working.
And if he will come: if he comes.
